name: Primitive Workbench
description: Primitive Workbench is a production crafting structure used to create basic items. It is the first crafting station available and is later upgraded by higher-tier workbenches.

name: Stone Axe
description: The Stone Axe is a tool in Palworld. The Stone Axe is a basic implement for chopping down trees, allowing for easy harvesting of Wood and Fiber. It can also be used as a weapon, though its low attack power makes it only suitable as an absolute last resort weapon.

name: Stone Pickaxe
description: The Stone Pickaxe is a tool in Palworld. The Stone Pickaxe is a basic implement for mining large rocks and  Ore nodes. It can also be used as a weapon, though its low attack power makes it only suited as an absolute last resort weapon.

name: Hand-Held Torch
description: The Hand-held Torch, also called the Torch, is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Hand-held Torch is used to provide light and warmth in a small area around the user. It is an invaluable early-game item for both exploring dark areas like Dungeons and staving off the cold of night. When used as a weapon...

name: Wooden Club
description: The Wooden Club is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Wooden Club is used for close-range combat against Pals and Humans. It offers low damage and durability, but is lightweight, inexpensive to craft, and very easy to replace.

name: Palbox
description: Palbox is the core Pal management structure used to establish a Base. It stores captured Pals, enables Pal assignment and inspection, and acts as the control center for base-related interactions.

name: Pal Sphere
description:
Pal Sphere is the lowest tier of Pal Spheres available to players. It is primarily used to capture low-level Pals and is commonly encountered early in the game.
Pal Spheres are throwable items used to capture wild Pals. When a Pal Sphere hits a Pal, it attempts to capture them, with success influenced...

name: Campfire
description:
The Campfire is a basic cooking structure used to prepare simple dishes from raw ingredients. It serves as an early-game food preparation option and supports limited cooking functionality.
As players progress, the Campfire is eventually replaced by more advanced cooking structures with broader recipe...

name: Wooden Chest
description: Wooden Chest is a storage structure used to hold items early in progression. While easy to construct, its wooden build offers limited durability and storage space.

name: Repair Bench
description: Repair Bench is a production structure used to restore durability to damaged equipment. It allows early-game repairs without the need to replace broken items entirely.

name: Wooden Structure Set
description: Once a set is unlocked, one can then build 19 basic structures, With the exception of the Japanese-Style Structure Set which has 23. These include walls, foundations, wall and window, triangular wall, roof, slanted roof, stairs, pillars, and doors.

name: Pal Dressing Facility
description: Pal Dressing Facility is a Pal-related structure used to apply cosmetic skins to Pals. Skins obtained both in-game and through external sources can be managed here.

name: Old Bow
description: The Old Bow is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Old Bow is a single-shot weapon that can fire Arrows, Fire Arrows, or Poison Arrows. While it deals low damage, it allows players to effectively take down enemies from range, making it a much safer option than the Wooden Club or the Stone Spear. Additionally...

name: Arrow
description:
Arrow is a type of Ammo. They are the weakest arrows in Palworld.
Ammo is used by ranged weapons such as bows, crossbows, firearms, and specialized launchers. Different ammo types determine the damage dealt, elemental effects applied, and which weapons they are compatible with. Some ammo inflicts additional...

name: Stone Spear
description: The Stone Spear is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Stone Spear is used for close-range combat against Pals and Humans. Its extended reach makes it safer to use than shorter melee weapons like the  Wooden Club when engaging enemies.

name: Shoddy Bed
description: Shoddy Bed is an infrastructure structure used to rest and recover. It provides a basic sleeping option early in progression, though comfort is limited without adequate shelter.

name: Straw Pal Bed
description: Straw Pal Bed is an infrastructure structure used by Pals to rest and recover SAN. It provides a minimal sleeping arrangement but is essential for proper Pal recovery within a base.

name: Global Palbox
description: The Global Palbox is a Pal management structure used to store and reconstruct Pals across different worlds.

name: Common Shield
description:
Common Shield is a Shield item which can be crafted and equipped by the Player. It grants 100 Shield while equipped and has 1,000 durability.
It is superseded by the Mega Shield.

name: Cloth Outfit
description: The Cloth Outfit is an armor piece in Palworld. The Cloth Outfit is an early-game piece of body armor that provides minimal protection as well as Lvl 1 Cold Resistance. While it isn't the best armor for combat, its innate cold protection helps keep the user warm during the cold nights in places like the Windswept Hills. However, it should not be used in especially cold places like the Frostbound Mountains.

name: Cloth
description: Cloth is a material. This item is craftable and is used in crafts. It is also obtainable from certain Pal drops.

name: Feed Box
description:
The Feed Box is a food storage structure used to hold meals for Pals within a base. Pals automatically eat from it when their hunger increases, making it a core structure for maintaining Pal well-being.
This structure serves as the primary food source for Pals before more advanced food storage options...

name: Berry Plantation
description:
The Berry Plantation is a farming structure that produces Red Berries. It supports both manual harvesting and automated production through Pals assigned to farming-related tasks.
Designed for early food production, the Berry Plantation provides a reliable source of berries with relatively short harvest...

name: Ranch
description: Ranch is a Pal training structure that allows compatible Pals to graze and periodically generate items while assigned to a base. Ranches function automatically once compatible Pals are deployed at a base, however pals with multiple work suitabilities treat Ranch grazing as a **secondary task** and may leave temporarily to perform other assigned jobs before returning.

name: Normal Parachute
description:
Normal Parachute is the first tier of Gliders. It allows players to glide through the air and is an early-game method of aerial movement. It's a tier 5 technology item and requires 2 points to unlock.
The Normal Parachute is used as a means of transportation. It is activated by pressing the jump button...

name: Wooden Tavern Cabinet Furniture Set
description: Each storage slot is capped at 9999. For example: A Wooden Chest has a storage capacity of 99990 items but has 10 unique item slots.

name: Pal Gear Workbench
description: Pal Gear Workbench is a production structure used to craft gear exclusively for Pals. It is the only crafting station capable of producing Pal Gear items.

name: Fire Arrow
description:
Fire Arrow is a type of Ammo.

name: Mounted Torch
description: Mounted Torch is a lighting structure used to illuminate areas of a base without requiring electricity. It relies on a Fire-type Pal to ignite and maintain the flame.

name: Sign
description: Sign is a utility structure used to display written messages within a base. It is commonly used for labeling areas, organizing storage, or leaving notes for other players.

name: Wall-Mounted Sign
description: Wall-Mounted Sign is a utility structure used to display short written messages. It functions similarly to a standard Sign but is designed to be placed on walls.

name: Rushoar Saddle
description: Rushoar Saddle is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Rushoar’s partner skill and is stored in the Key Items section of the player’s inventory. Once crafted, Pal Gear does not need to be repeatedly equipped. Unlocking and crafting the item permanently enables the Pal’s partner skill, allowing it to be activated whenever the Pal is deployed.

name: Monitoring Stand
description: Monitoring Stand is a Pal management structure used to control how Pals behave and work inside a base. It provides centralized options for assigning tasks, adjusting work intensity, and restricting specific types of work.

name: Bat
description:
Bat is a melee weapon that offers higher attack power than earlier tools, making it more effective against tougher enemies while remaining lightweight and easy to wield.
The Bat is used for close-range combat against Pals and Humans. Its increased attack power compared to basic weapons makes it a reliable...

name: Logging Site
description: Logging Site is a production structure used to generate  Wood at a base. It relies on Pal labor and is best operated by Pals skilled in logging-related work.

name: Stone Pit
description: Stone Pit is a production structure used to generate  Stone through Pal labor. It provides a steady source of stone when operated by Pals skilled in mining.

name: Sandbag
description: Sandbag is a defensive structure used to assign a Pal to guard a base area. When in use, the assigned Pal prioritizes combat readiness over other tasks.

name: Alarm Bell
description:
The Alarm Bell is a defensive structure that allows base-wide control over Pal behavior during hostile situations. By setting the alert status, it determines whether Pals prioritize engaging invading enemies or continue focusing on assigned work tasks.
This structure provides manual control over base...

name: Melpaca Saddle
description: Melpaca Saddle is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Melpaca’s partner skill and is stored in the Key Items section of the player’s inventory. Once crafted, Pal Gear does not need to be repeatedly equipped. Unlocking and crafting the item permanently enables the Pal’s partner skill, allowing it to be activated whenever the Pal is deployed.

name: Wall-Mounted Houseplant Set
description: Furniture is used primarily to decorate one's base, though a few items may have additional functions.

name: Crusher
description:
The Crusher is a production structure used to break down materials and convert items into alternate resources. Operated through a water-driven mechanism, it relies on Pal labor to process inputs into refined outputs.
This structure is later superseded by the Refrigerated Crusher.

name: Wooden Defensive Wall
description: Wooden Defensive Wall is a defensive wall structure used to protect a base from enemy intrusions. Constructed from wood, it provides minimal durability compared to stronger wall materials.

name: Wooden Gate
description: Wooden Gate is a defensive wall structure used to control access through base boundaries. Constructed from wood, it offers limited durability compared to stronger gate materials.

name: Hanging Trap
description: Hanging Trap is a defensive structure used to automatically ensnare small-sized Pals and some humans that pass through its trigger area. When triggered, the trap hangs the target in place, preventing movement and making it far easier to capture them with Spheres or deal with them strategically in combat or trapping setups.

name: Statue of Power
description: The Statue of Power is a structure in Palworld. The Statue of Power is used to to increase a Pal's stats or increase a player's Capture Power. Statues of Power can be constructed by players or found naturally throughout the world, with both versions functioning identically.

name: Small Feed Bag
description: Small Feed Bag is a Key Item that unlocks a dedicated food slot in the inventory. Food placed in this slot is automatically consumed by the Player and Party Pals when they become hungry. The Small Feed Bag provides one food slot and is an early-game quality-of-life upgrade for managing hunger.

name: Tropical Outfit
description:
Tropical Outfit is an armor the player can use, designed for surviving hot environments early in progression. Armor is worn to improve survivability by increasing defense, health, and providing resistance to environmental hazards.
As a heat-adapted variant of the Cloth Outfit, the Tropical Outfit grants...

name: Tundra Outfit
description:
Tundra Outfit is an armor the player can use, designed for surviving freezing environments early in progression. Armor is worn to improve survivability by increasing defense, health, and providing resistance to environmental hazards.
As a cold-adapted variant of the Cloth Outfit, the Tundra Outfit grants...

name: Hot Spring
description: Hot Spring is a health care structure that allows working Pals to relax and recover SAN while at a base. It serves as an early-game solution for maintaining Pal well-being and preventing productivity loss.

name: Direhowl's Saddled Harness
description: Direhowl's Saddled Harness is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Direhowl’s partner skill and is stored in the *Key Items* section of the player’s inventory. Once crafted, Pal Gear does not need to be repeatedly equipped. Unlocking and crafting the item permanently enables the Pal’s partner skill, allowing...

name: Primitive Furnace
description: Primitive Furnace is a production refinement structure used to smelt basic materials. It is the earliest furnace available and is later upgraded by the Improved Furnace.

name: Three Shot Bow
description: The Three Shot Bow is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Three-Shot Bow is a single-shot weapon that can fire Arrows, Fire Arrows, or Poison Arrows. As its name suggests, it has the ability to fire three arrows at once while only consuming one, letting it deal far more damage than the Old Bow. However...

name: Feathered Hair Band
description: Feathered Hair Band is an armor the player can use, designed to provide basic head protection early in progression. Armor is worn to improve survivability by increasing defense, health, or resistance to damage, with different pieces offering varying levels of protection depending on their tier and materials...

name: Nail
description: Nail is a material used in the crafting of various structures and items. It's a tier 10 technology item and requires 1 technology point to unlock. It requires a Primitive Workbench or better to craft.

name: Ladder
description: Ladder is a structure within the Foundations category.

name: Bear Trap (Small)
description:
The Bear Trap (Small) is a defensive structure designed to immobilize small Pals when triggered. While trapped, affected Pals become easier to capture with Pal Spheres and are left vulnerable to follow-up actions.
This trap is intended specifically for small Pals and does not activate on larger variants...

name: Antique Storage Set
description: Each storage slot is capped at 9999. For example: A Wooden Chest has a storage capacity of 99990 items but has 10 unique item slots.

name: Egg Incubator
description:
The Egg Incubator is a Pal-focused structure used to hatch Pal Eggs. Unlike the Electric Egg Incubator, it does not require electricity to operate and instead relies on environmental temperature conditions to determine incubation speed.
Eggs placed inside the incubator will hatch automatically over time...

name: Metal Axe
description: The Metal Axe is a tool in Palworld. Like the  Stone Axe, the Metal Axe is used to chop down trees for  Wood and  Fiber. However, it also comes with the "Logging Yield Up Lv. 1" bonus, letting it harvest around twice as many resources from a single tree.

name: Metal Pickaxe
description: The Metal Pickaxe is a tool in Palworld. Like the Stone Pickaxe, the Metal Pickaxe is used to harvest resources like Stone and Ore from larger nodes. However, it comes with the "Mining Yield Up Lv. 1" bonus, letting it harvest around twice as many resources from a single node.

name: High Quality Workbench
description: High Quality Workbench is a production structure used for crafting items and gear through Pal-assisted handiwork. It serves as a mid-tier crafting station, bridging the gap between basic workbenches and more specialized production facilities.

name: Rayne Syndicate Flag Set

description:

name: Meat Cleaver
description: The Meat Cleaver is a tool in Palworld. The Meat Cleaver is used for butchering the player's Pals, letting them obtain their drops once again after catching them. Though this action can be quite lucrative, especially if the Pal being butchered is an  Alpha and will drop valuable items or even legendary-tier  Schematics, Pals that are butchered will die permanently. As such, the user must be very careful when selecting which Pals they want to kill.

name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
description: Medieval Medicine Workbench is a production structure used for crafting basic medicine items. It serves as the entry-level station for medicine production and relies on Pal labor to operate.

name: Metal Spear
description: The Metal Spear is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Metal Spear is used for close-range combat against Pals and Humans. Its extended reach allows players to attack from a slightly greater distance, while the metal tip provides significantly increased attack power.

name: Metal Chest
description: Metal Chest is a storage structure used to hold items at a base. Its metal reinforcement makes it more durable than basic chests while providing additional storage space.

name: Cooler Box
description:
The Cooler Box is a storage structure used to hold food items while reducing spoilage. Designed as an early cold-storage option, it helps maintain a more stable food supply within a base.
This structure provides limited storage capacity and serves as a compact alternative to larger refrigerated food...

name: Training Dummy
description: Training Dummy is a utility structure used to test weapons and combat mechanics in a controlled environment. It is designed to withstand repeated attacks without being destroyed.

description: Each storage slot is capped at 9999. For example: A Wooden Chest has a storage capacity of 99990 items but has 10 unique item slots.

name: Mega Sphere
description:
Mega Spheres are the second tier of Pal Spheres and have a Capture Power of 14. They can be collected off the ground in various parts of the map or crafted. Additionally, they are a possible drop from a 4-Star Vixy when assigned to a Ranch. They are green in color.

name: Sphere Workbench
description: Sphere Workbench is a production structure used to craft Pal Spheres. It serves as an early-game crafting station with limited production capacity and is the predecessor to the Sphere Assembly Line, which offers faster production and support for multiple Pals.

name: Average Feed Bag
description: Average Feed Bag is a Key Item that passively feeds Pals in a player's party. It unlocks two food slots, allowing players and Pals to automatically consume food when hungry.

name: Wall Torch
description: Wall Torch is a lighting structure used to provide illumination within a base. It is mounted on walls and helps improve visibility during nighttime and low-light conditions.

description: Pal Essence Condenser is a Pal training structure used for Pal Condensation, a process that strengthens a Pal by sacrificing other Pals of the same species.

name: Beginner Fishing Set
description: Beginner Fishing Rod (Chillet) is the most basic Fishing Rod. It can be used to initiate the Fishing Minigames for both Pals and Salvage.

name: Wheat Plantation
description: Wheat Plantation is a food production structure used to grow  Wheat. It supports both manual harvesting and automated farming when operated by Pals with appropriate work suitabilities.

name: Mill
description: Mill is a production structure used exclusively to process Wheat into Flour. It relies on Pal labor and water-powered operation to function.

description: Viewing Cage is a Pal storage structure used to hold captured Pals outside of active base assignments. Pals placed inside are kept safe and do not require food.

It is a tier 22 technology item and costs 2 points to unlock. It can be crafted at a Primitive Workbench or higher.

description:

It is an upgrade from the Common Shield and is superseded by the Giga Shield.

name: Lockpicking Tool v1
description: The Lockpicking Tool v1 is a Key Item in Palworld. The Lockpicking Tool v1 can be used to unlock Treasure Chests that normally require a  Copper Key to be opened. Unlike keys, the Lockpicking Tool is not consumed or broken when used, meaning you only ever need one to unlock an unlimited number of Treasure Chests.

name: Primitive Sword
description: The Primitive Sword is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Primitive Sword is a good early-game weapon for close-quarters combat. While it has less range than the  Metal Spear, it has over double the  Attack power and twice the  Durability.

name: Cooking Pot
description:
The Cooking Pot is a cooking structure used to prepare a broader range of food items than basic cooking facilities. It supports more complex recipes and improved meal variety, making it a key upgrade for base food production.
Positioned as a mid-tier cooking station, the Cooking Pot bridges the gap between...

name: Heater
description: Heater is an infrastructure structure that provides localized warmth when powered by a Fire Pal. It is primarily used to regulate temperature-sensitive systems and environments within a base.

name: Tombstone
description: Tombstone is a decorative structure that can be inscribed with custom text. While it has no functional impact on gameplay systems, it is commonly used for memorials, markers, or record keeping within a base.

name: Ring of Mercy
description:
The Ring of Mercy is an accessory in Palworld.
When equipped, the Ring of Mercy makes it so that the player’s attacks will not reduce their target's Health below 1, making it easier to weaken Pals or enemy Humans for capture without accidentally defeating them. This effect also applies to the player...

name: Heavy Weight Module
description:
Heavy Weight Module is a Sphere Module which can be crafted and equipped by the player. It grants 1 Capture Power and adds 1 Sphere Weight, making Spheres heavier but more efficient.
It is the first Sphere Module the player can unlock and comes with a downside, eventually superseded by the Curve Module...

name: Cement
description:
Cement is a material. It is used as a crafting ingredient of many items.
It is a tier 19 Technology and costs 1 point to unlock. It can be crafted at High Quality Workbench or better.

name: Defensive Wall
description: The Defensive Wall is a defensive structure designed to prevent enemy intrusions and reinforce base perimeters. Constructed from stone and cement, it provides a durable barrier against hostile threats.

name: Stone Gate

description: Weapon Workbench is a production structure used to craft weapons, tools, and ammunition. name: Musket
description: The Musket is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Musket is a single-shot weapon that uses  Coarse Ammo. It deals high damage per shot and is very accurate, making it good for long-ranged combat. However, the Musket's single-shot nature and long reload time makes it somewhat ineffective in close-quarters combat. Additionally, it shares its ammo type with several other weapons like the  Makeshift Handgun, though its abysmally slow rate of fire means that the Musket isn't likely to burn through ammo quickly.

name: Gunpowder
description: Gunpowder is a highly useful material for crafting ammo for weapons. It is a tier 21 technology item and costs 2 points to unlock. It can be crafted at a High Quality Workbench or better.

name: Coarse Ammo
description: Coarse Ammo is a type of ammo in Palworld. Coarse Ammo is used in the  Musket,  Makeshift Handgun,  Makeshift SMG,  Makeshift Shotgun, and  Makeshift Assault Rifle.

name: Tomato Plantation
description: Tomato Plantation is a food production structure used to grow  Tomatoes. It supports both manual harvesting and automated farming when operated by Pals with appropriate work suitabilities.

name: Flame Cauldron
description:
The Flame Cauldron is an efficiency enhancement structure that improves fire-related work within a base. It passively increases the speed of tasks performed by Pals with the Kindling work suitability.
This structure provides a base-wide effect and does not require manual interaction once constructed...

name: Bear Trap (Large)
description:
The Bear Trap (Large) is a defensive structure designed to immobilize large Pals when triggered. While trapped, affected Pals become easier to capture with Pal Spheres and are left vulnerable to follow-up actions.
This trap is intended specifically for large Pals and does not activate on smaller variants...

name: Vanwyrm Saddle
description: Vanwyrm Saddle is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Vanwyrm’s partner skill and is stored in the Key Items section of the player’s inventory. Once crafted, Pal Gear does not need to be repeatedly equipped. Unlocking and crafting the item permanently enables the Pal’s partner skill, allowing it to be activated whenever the Pal is deployed.

name: Antique Dresser
description:
The Antique Dresser is a furniture structure that allows appearance customization through interaction. As part of the ancient technology line, it provides cosmetic functionality rather than mechanical or production-related benefits.
Often used as a decorative utility item, the Antique Dresser enables...

name: Pal Expedition Station
description: Pal Expedition Station is a Pal management structure used to send Pals on Expeditions. Dispatched Pals travel to designated locations, participate in encounters, and return with collected items and materials.

name: Stun Baton
description: The Stun Baton is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Stun Baton electrocutes Pals and Humans on hit, briefly stunning them. While it deals very low damage, electrocuted Pals are easier to capture, making the Stun Baton useful as a support tool during captures rather than as a primary combat weapon.

name: High Quality Bait
description:
High Quality Bait is a Consumable item.
High Quality Bait is used in Fishing to be able to catch Pals. It is the second tier of bait and offers a slight bonus to the speed Pals will bite with after casting the Fishing Rod.

name: Flea Market (Items)
description: The Flea Market (Items) is a structure that enables the sale of items to other players through a trading interface. By assigning items to its sales list, it facilitates cooperative trading on servers where multiple players are present.

name: Flea Market (Pals)
description: The Flea Market (Pals) is a structure that enables the sale of Pals to other players through a trading interface. By placing Pals on its sales list, it supports player-to-player trading on multiplayer servers.

name: Vanwyrm Cryst Saddle
description: Vanwyrm Cryst Saddle is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Vanwyrm Cryst’s partner skill and is stored in the Key Items section of the player’s inventory. name: Homeward Thundercloud
description:
Homeward Thundercloud is a consumable that teleports the player to the nearest base when used.
It is a tier 30 ancient technology item and requires 2 points to unlock.

name: Metal Armor
description:
Metal Armor is an armor the player can use, designed to provide strong protection through high defense and durability. Armor is worn to improve survivability in combat and exploration, offering bonuses such as increased defense, additional health, and resistance to environmental effects.
As an upgrade...

name: Metal Helm
description:
Metal Helm is an armor the player can use, designed to provide strong head protection through increased defense and durability. Armor is worn to improve survivability in combat and exploration, offering bonuses such as increased defense and additional health.
As a heavier helmet option, the Metal Helm...

name: Curve Module
description:
Curve Module is a Sphere Module that can be equipped by the player to modify how Spheres behave. When equipped, it causes thrown spheres to curve, making them harder to use but improving capture effectiveness.
It is the second Sphere Module available to the player and is eventually outclassed by the...

name: Large Feed Bag
description:
Large Feed Bag is a Key Item that passively feeds Pals in a player's party. It unlocks three food slots, allowing both players and Pals to automatically consume food when hunger is reached.
Crafting the Large Feed Bag increases the number of available food storage slots from two to three, allowing for...

name: Water Fountain
description: Water Fountain is an efficiency enhancement structure that improves watering performance within a base. Its effect does not stack when multiple fountains are placed.

description: Furniture is used primarily to decorate one's base, though a few items may have additional functions.

name: Storage Container Set
description: Each storage slot is capped at 9999. For example: A Wooden Chest has a storage capacity of 99990 items but has 10 unique item slots.

name: Makeshift Handgun
description: The Makeshift Handgun is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Makeshift Handgun is a semi-automatic weapon that uses  Coarse Ammo. While it doesn't deal as much damage per shot as the  Musket, its higher rate of fire, larger magazine capacity, and faster reload time makes it much better for close-quarters combat. However, the Makeshift Handgun does share its ammo type with the Musket and other makeshift weapons, making ammo management important when using it.

name: Fluffy Pal Bed
description:
The Fluffy Pal Bed is a bedding structure used by Pals for resting and recovery. Pals assigned to a base will sleep in beds at night or rest in them when injured.
Providing beds is necessary for proper Pal rest. Without an available bed, Pals are unable to sleep soundly and will not recover SAN during...

name: Medicine Rack
description: Medicine Rack is a health care structure used to store medicine and automate Pal treatment at a base. When medicine is available, sick Pals will seek it out on their own without player intervention.

name: Clinic
description:
A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base.

Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury.

While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

name: Flower Bed
description:
The Flower Bed is an efficiency structure that improves resource gathering within a base. It passively increases the work speed of Pals assigned to gathering-related tasks.
This structure provides a base-wide effect and does not require manual interaction once constructed.

name: Boost Gun
description: Boost Gun is a ranged weapon in Palworld that can be used to both damage enemies and temporarily boost allied Pals. When fired at a Pal in the player's party, it increases that Pal’s attack and defense by 5% for a short time; when fired at enemies, it deals damage instead.

description:

name: Lettuce Plantation
description: Lettuce Plantation is a farming structure used to produce Lettuce at a base. Lettuce grown here expands the variety of meals that can be prepared and supports more advanced cooking recipes.

name: Silo
description: Silo is an efficiency enhancement structure that improves agricultural productivity within a base. Its effect is limited to planting tasks and does not stack when multiple silos are placed.

name: Frag Grenade
description: The Frag Grenade is a weapon in Palworld. The Frag Grenade is a thrown explosive that deals AOE damage to anything in its blast radius. It's a good early-to-midgame weapon for dealing with large groups of enemies, letting players clear out entire crowds with relative ease.

name: Lockpicking Tool v2
description: The Lockpicking Tool v2 is a Key Item in Palworld. The Lockpicking Tool v2 can be used to unlock Treasure Chests that normally require a  Copper Key or  Silver Key to be opened. Unlike keys, the Lockpicking Tool is not consumed or broken when used, meaning you only ever need one to unlock an unlimited number of Treasure Chests.

name: Makeshift SMG
description: The Makeshift SMG is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Makeshift SMG is a rapid-fire, automatic weapon that uses  Coarse Ammo. While it deals low damage per shot, its high rate of fire and large magazine capacity allows it to deal quick bursts of damage, making it effective at clearing out weaker foes. However, since the Makeshift SMG uses the same ammo type as other makeshift weapons, its high fire rate means that the user can burn through ammo if they aren't careful.

name: Power Generator
description: Power Generator is an infrastructure structure used to generate and store electric power at a base. It enables the operation of electrically powered facilities and is later superseded by the Large Power Generator.

name: Lamp
description: Lamp is a lighting structure used to illuminate bases after dark. Compared to basic light sources, it provides a larger illumination radius but requires electrical power to operate.

name: Human-Powered Generator
description: Human-Powered Generator is an infrastructure structure that provides an early–mid-game method of generating electricity for a base without requiring Pals with the Generating Electricity work suitability, though efficiency is low compared to other generators.

name: Mounted Crossbow
description: Mounted Crossbow is a defensive structure that allows an assigned Pal to operate a mounted ranged weapon for base defense. When supplied with arrows, it automatically attacks hostile targets within range.

name: Polapup Saddle
description:
Polapup Saddle is a Pal Gear item.
Pal Gear is equipment designed for use by Pals. It enables specific abilities, actions, or interactions that are not available by default. Pal Gear is unlocked through technology and is typically crafted to access specific Pal-related features or mechanics.

name: Hyper Sphere
description:
Hyper Spheres are the fourth tier of Pal Spheres. They are a Technology unlockable at level 27. They are scarlet in color.
Pal Spheres are throwable items used to capture wild Pals. When a Pal Sphere hits a Pal, it attempts to capture them, with success determined by the sphere’s Capture Power, the Pal...

name: Sphere Assembly Line
description: Sphere Assembly Line is a production structure used to craft Pal Spheres at increased speeds. It serves as an upgrade to the Sphere Workbench and supports collaborative work by multiple Pals. The next powerful sphere crafting station is Sphere Assembly Line II which offers further improvements to production capability.

name: Cold Resistant Metal Armor
description:
Cold Resistant Metal Armor is an armor the player can use, designed to provide heavy protection with an emphasis on cold resistance. Armor is worn to improve survivability in combat and exploration, offering increased defense, additional health, and resistance to environmental hazards.
As an upgrade...

name: Small Pouch
description: The Small Pouch is a Key Item in Palworld. The Small Pouch increases the size of the player's Inventory by three slots, allowing more items to be carried at once.

name: Ceiling Lamp
description:
The Ceiling Lamp is a ceiling-mounted lighting structure that illuminates a large area within a base. Designed for overhead placement, it provides stronger and more consistent lighting than smaller light sources.
This structure requires electricity to operate and is commonly used to light large indoor...

name: Shock Grenade
description: The Shock Grenade is a weapon in Palworld. Like the standard  Frag Grenade, the Shock Grenade is a thrown explosive that deals AOE damage. However, it deals  Electric-element damage, making it great at dealing with  Water-element Pals. The Shock Grenade also has a chance to electrify enemies, stunning them and making them easier to catch.

These qualities make the Handgun a much better close-quarters weapon than its makeshift counterpart.

description: Anti-Gravity Belt is a Accessory item.

name: Giga Shield
description:
Giga Shield is a Shield item that can be crafted and equipped by the player. While equipped, it grants 540 shield and has 2,250 durability.
It is an upgrade from the Mega Shield and is superseded by the Hyper Shield.

name: Sword
description: The Sword is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Sword is a good mid-game weapon for close-range combat. In addition to fighting enemies, it can also be used to chop trees and mine rocks, making it a good multitool.

name: Intermediate Fishing Rod (Cattiva)
description: Intermediate Fishing Rod (Cattiva) is a Fishing Rod.

name: Production Assembly Line
description: Production Assembly Line is a production crafting structure used to manufacture higher-tier items more efficiently than earlier workbenches. It is an upgrade to the High Quality Workbench and is later superseded by the Production Assembly Line II.

name: Potato Plantation
description: Potato Plantation is a farming structure used to produce Potatoes at a base. Potatoes grown here increase the variety of meals that can be prepared.

name: Ice Grenade
description: The Ice Grenade is a weapon in Palworld. Like the standard  Frag Grenade, the Ice Grenade is a thrown explosive that deals AOE damage. However, it deals  Ice-element damage, making it great at dealing with  Dragon-element Pals. The Ice Grenade also has a chance to freeze enemies, immobilizing them and making them easier to catch.

name: Enhanced Hip Lantern
description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. You can also switch its lighting mode to keep it on at all times.

name: Makeshift Shotgun
description: The Makeshift Shotgun is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Makeshift Shotgun is a single-shot weapon that uses  Coarse Ammo. It fires a spread of pellets that deal heavy damage up close, though it suffers from limited range and relatively low  Durability. Additionally, the Makeshift Shotgun uses the same ammo type as other makeshift weapons, though its slow fire rate and single-shot nature means that it's highly unlikely to burn through ammo.

name: Mine
description: Mine is a defensive trap structure that explodes when triggered by a Pal, damaging targets within its blast radius. It is primarily used to weaken or eliminate enemies entering defended areas.

name: Metal Structure Set
description: Once a set is unlocked, one can then build 19 basic structures, With the exception of the Japanese-Style Structure Set which has 23. These include walls, foundations, wall and window, triangular wall, roof, slanted roof, stairs, pillars, and doors.

name: Metal Defensive Wall
description: Metal Defensive Wall is a defensive wall structure used to fortify a base against hostile threats. Its metal construction provides exceptional durability, making it ideal for perimeter defenses and chokepoints.

name: Iron Gate
description: Iron Gate is a defensive wall structure used to control access points in a base while maintaining strong protection. Its wide opening allows even large Pals to pass through without compromising structural durability.

name: Pickaxe and Helmet
description: Mining Cart is an efficiency enhancement structure that provides a base-wide bonus to  Mining work speed for Pals. It requires Research before it can be unlocked in the technology tree.

name: Mushroom Cake
description: Cakes are a category of Food items in Palworld. While they have high  Nutrition and Sanity restoration values, their primary purpose is to be placed in a  Breeding Farm in order to make Pals produce  Pal Eggs when assigned to them.

description:
Not to be confused with the Legendary Meowmere.
The Meowmere is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Meowmere is a sword that fires bouncing, explosive cat-shaped projectiles that deal AOE damage, making it highly effective against groups of enemies.
The Meowmere is a part of the Palworld-Terraria crossover...

name: Makeshift Assault Rifle
description: The Makeshift Assault Rifle is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Makeshift Assault Rifle is an automatic weapon that uses  Coarse Ammo. Though it fires slower than the  Makeshift SMG and has a smaller magazine capacity, it has higher  Durability, deals more damage per shot, and is more accurate, making it better at longer ranges. However, since the Makeshift Assault Rifle uses the same ammo type as other makeshift weapons, ammo management is important when using it.

name: Sniper Module
description:
Sniper Module is a Sphere Module that can be crafted and equipped by the Player. When equipped, it increases Capture Power and significantly extends the distance that Spheres can be thrown, allowing for long-range captures.
It is the third Sphere Module the Player can unlock through technology. It is...

name: Cryogenic Coolant
description: A high-efficiency cooling medium made from special components derived from Pals. Used to regulate temperature in high-output devices.

name: Fishing Pond
description: The Fishing Pond is a production structure that enables automated fishing within a base. When operated by an assigned Pal, it allows fish and other fishing-related rewards to be obtained without direct player involvement.

name: High Quality Hot Spring
description: High Quality Hot Spring is an upgraded health care structure that improves Pal well-being by restoring SAN more efficiently than a standard Hot Spring. It provides a comfortable resting area that helps maintain Pal happiness and long-term productivity at a base.

name: Incendiary Grenade
description: The Incendiary Grenade is a weapon in Palworld. Like the standard  Frag Grenade, the Incendiary Grenade is a thrown explosive that deals AOE damage. However, it deals  Fire-element damage, making it great at dealing with  Grass and  Ice-element Pals. The Incendiary Grenade also has a chance to burn enemies, dealing damage over time and making them easier to catch.

It is itself upgraded further by the Weapon Assembly Line II.

name: Pal Recovery Grenade
description: The Pal Recovery Grenade is a weapon in Palworld. Instead of dealing damage like other grenades, the Pal Recovery Grenade heals any allied Pals in its blast radius. It comes in especially handy when fighting Raid Bosses, allowing players to quickly heal their team to get them back in the fight faster. However, as the Pal Recovery Grenade requires the rare  Cavern Mushrooms to be crafted, obtaining many of them can be difficult.

name: Carrot Plantation

description: Summoning Altar is a special-purpose structure used to summon powerful Raid Boss Pals into a Pal Base or Raid Area. These encounters are intended as high-difficulty challenges and require preparation before activation.

name: Improved Furnace
description: Improved Furnace is a production structure used to smelt and refine materials at a higher tier than the Primitive Furnace. It supports the creation of Refined Ingot and offers improved processing speed, though it still relies on Pal labor for operation.

name: Refined Metal Axe
description: The Refined Metal Axe is a tool in Palworld. The Refined Metal Axe is a great mid-game tool for harvesting  Wood and  Fiber, able to harvest much of those resources from a single tree with its "Logging Yield Up Lv. 2" bonus. Additionally, it can also harvest  Hardwood from trees that grow in places like Mount Obsidian or the Desiccated Dunes.

name: Refined Metal Pickaxe
description: The Refined Metal Pickaxe is a tool in Palworld. The Refined Metal Pickaxe is a great mid-game tool for harvesting resources like  Stone and  Ore, able to harvest much of those resources from a single node with its "Mining Yield Up Lv. 2" bonus.

name: Refined Metal Spear
description: The Refined Metal Spear is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Refined Metal Spear is used for close-range combat against Pals and Humans. Its long reach allows players to keep distance while attacking, and its refined metal tip provides substantially higher attack power than earlier spears.

name: Triple Jump Boots
description: Triple Jump Boots is a Accessory item.

name: Skillfruit Orchard
description: Skillfruit Orchard is a food production structure used to cultivate Skillfruits. By planting an existing Skillfruit, multiple fruits of the same type can be grown and harvested over time.

name: Azure Covenant Flag Set
description: Furniture is used primarily to decorate one's base, though a few items may have additional functions.

name: Whalaska Ignis Saddle
description: Whalaska Ignis Saddle is a piece of Pal Gear used to unlock Whalaska Ignis’s partner skill and is stored in the Key Items section of the player’s inventory. Once crafted, Pal Gear does not need to be repeatedly equipped. Unlocking and crafting the item permanently enables the Pal’s partner skill, allowing it to be activated whenever the Pal is deployed.

name: Tactical Grenade Launcher
description: The Tactical Grenade Launcher is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Tactical Grenade Launcher is a semi-automatic weapon that uses  Tactical Grenade Launcher Ammo. It deals far more damage than the regular  Grenade Launcher and has a higher magazine capacity, making it even better for dealing with large groups and durable single targets. The Tactical Grenade Launcher also fires its grenades at a higher velocity, making it better at hitting targets from further away.

name: Soralite Quarry
description: Soralite Quarry is a production structure that enables the automated gathering of  Soralite by assigned Pals with Mining suitability. Due to the physically demanding nature of extracting Soralite , this structure relies entirely on Pal labor.

name: Laser Sword
description: The Laser Sword is a melee weapon in Palworld. The Laser Sword is a late-game weapon with the same attack pattern as the  Katana and  Beam Sword as well as the ability to fire off an energy wave with its charged slash attack. However, it deals far more damage than the Beam Sword, making it much better for close-quarters combat.

name: Gold Coin Assembly Line
description: The Gold Coin Assembly Line is a production structure used to convert ingots into Gold Coins, the primary currency in Palworld. It requires electricity to operate and must be staffed by Pals capable of performing Handiwork tasks.

name: Paloxite Ingot
description: An indomitable alloy created by fusing Soralite and Paloxite. A highly rare material, crystallizing the technology of ancient civilization and the power of the World Tree.

name: Ancient Relic Recycler
description: Ancient Relic Recycler is a lategame crafting device used to recycle various Ancient Relics obtained from Pals within the World Tree.

name: Special Cake
description: Cakes are a category of Food items in Palworld. While they have high  Nutrition and Sanity restoration values, their primary purpose is to be placed in a  Breeding Farm in order to make Pals produce  Pal Eggs when assigned to them.

name: Beam Scatter
description: The Beam Scatter is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Beam Scatter is an automatic weapon that uses  Beam Scatter Ammo. While it deals less damage than the  Prototype Shotgun, its automatic nature and higher magazine capacity make it better for dealing quick bursts of damage.

name: Drone Launcher
description: The Drone Launcher is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Drone Launcher is a semi-automatic weapon that summons up to 9 attack drones that hover around the player. Like the  Terraprisma's swords, these drones will automatically seek out and attack the nearest enemy upon entering combat, returning to the player once all foes have been defeated. The drones will persist even when switching weapons, though they will vanish if the Drone Launcher is unequipped.

name: Plasma Rifle
description: The Plasma Rifle is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Plasma Rifle is a rapid-fire, automatic weapon that uses  Plasma Rifle Ammo. When its shots hit something, they release an electrical discharge that strikes any nearby enemies. This ability, combined with the Plasma Rifle's high  Attack power and large magazine capacity, makes it excellent at dealing with large groups.

name: Ancient Material Synthesizer
description: Ancient Material Synthesizer is a special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore. Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.

name: Ancient Farm
description: Ancient Farm is a type of Farming structure. A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island. Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots. It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.

name: Beam Launcher
description: The Beam Launcher is a ranged weapon in Palworld. The Beam Launcher is a semi-automatic weapon that uses  Beam Launcher Ammo. It fires explosive energy bolts that deal heavy splash damage, making it good at dealing with groups or tanky single targets. It also has a bottomless magazine, though it will overheat and require cooling down after three consecutive shots.

name: Wing Pack
description: The Wing Pack is a glider in Palworld. The Wing Pack is a special glider that allows for true flight, letting players fly anywhere they wish without having to use a flying Pal. This also allows players to free up a party slot for any type of Pal they may choose. However, the Wing Pack requires  Wing Cells in order to actually fly.
